info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Consumer Investments Management API
info.description: The Consumer Investments Management API facilitates the seamless creation and management of consumer investment portfolios. This API allows financial institutions to handle various investment products, enabling them to offer tailored investment solutions to individuals. Typical use cases include onboarding new clients, managing portfolio allocations, and tracking performance. This API is designed for use by financial advisors, banks, and investment firms looking to enhance their consumer investment offerings.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new investment under their consumer services. It facilitates the initiation of investment entries by accepting required parameters and processing them to establish a new record in the system.
